text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket delivered splendid results 
in the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years."

And so, one day while still basking in the 
afterglow of that major milestone—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Traineeeeee-r!! Guess what, guess what, 
guess what!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wanna go watch the Japanese Derby!?

And so, I came to watch the Japan Derby 
together with Winning Ticket.

As a star-studded lineup enters the gates, 
Winning Ticket's eyes sparkle with 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa! That's incredible! It's the 
strongest lineup of the Classic class!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder who's gonna win~~? Isn't this 
thrilling, Trainer!!"

—And with that, the gates opened and the 
race began!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOAAAHHHHH!!

The pack rushed across the turf, cloaked 
in a terrifying intensity—

Before long, past the fourth corner and 
onto the final stretch, a fierce battle 
for the lead broke out!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaaaaa~~!! Awesome, awesome, you're so 
awesome~~!!
(UWAAAAAAAHHH--!!)

The intensely heated Japan Derby drew to a 
close amidst thunderous cheers.

Some Umamusume were in tears, others 
exchanged firm handshakes; it was a 
bustling racecourse full of individual 
drama, but—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOAAAAAHHHH!! I'm! So! MOOOOOVED!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: THE DERBY!! IT'S THE FREAKING BEST--!!

Not to be outdone, Winning Ticket was 
stirring up an incredible amount of 
excitement too...!
choice_data_list: You really do love the Derby, don't you?
You really do love the Derby, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah...! It's a race I've always dreamed 
of running ever since I was little, after 
all—"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Besides—when I remember that I used to be 
out there too, running alongside Taishin 
and Hayahide...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Deep down in my chest, it goes all 
squeeeze-tight~~!

Winning Ticket, who had her sights set on 
the Japanese Derby ever since her debut.

Having magnificently fulfilled her dream, 
the fierce battle she fought on that grand 
stage remained in the hearts of many.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Really, so much has happened~~.

—Suddenly, they turned toward me as if 
recalling something.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aha!! That's right!! There was something I 
wanted to tell you today, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Sooooooo much has happened since the 
Twinkle Series started, but still!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Still, Trainer, you kept believing in me 
the whole time, didn't you?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Even when I lost all my confidence—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm... scared to run in the Derby right 
now...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And also when Hayahide and Taishin told me 
I wasn't their rival.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What's the difference between who I was at 
the Derby and who I am now?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Even when I was a totally hopeless 
screwup, Trainer, you believed in me the 
whole time!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I know Winning Ticket can do her best!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Thank you for always believing in me!!

Winning Ticket looked at me with an 
unusually serious expression.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Running the Arima Kinen made me realize I 
wanna run in sooooo many more races!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"And then, I wanna get even more pumped 
up!! I want everyone else to feel the 
thrill, too!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I want to become an Umamusume who can give 
people even more wonderful dreams!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So――Trainer. Once again, I look forward to 
working with you!

Back then, Winning Ticket was just a 
rookie Umamusume whose sole, earnest focus 
was aiming for the "Japanese Derby."

Having stumbled and persevered through 
these past three years, Winning Ticket has 
now grown into an admirable Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Same here, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ehehehe...!

And so, in order to run a race that can 
give dreams to so many people—

My days walking alongside Winning Ticket 
have begun once again!
